notes:
iPads reconnect by themselves, and taking a girl off a pole.

- iPads (and every screen) catch up by themselves after being locked or asleep: as soon as they're unlocked, or on their own within about 20 seconds. A "Tap to reconnect" button shows on the red bar meanwhile.
- The pole card on the DJ screen has "Take off…" and ⋯ next to the girl. The pole goes DARK until NEXT, then the next girl goes up for a whole set.
- With both poles on, the next VIP girl no longer goes up in the middle of the set (she used to lose most of her turn).
